messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — p99 latency breach for Cyclone Systems (vpc-eu-west-3). Impact: elevated p95/p99, some timed-out requests. Pager: Priya (oncall)
Priya (oncall): Got it. Paging SREs — @Alex SRE @Jamal (infra). Priya here taking lead. Can someone paste current p95/p99 + top routes? :eyes:
Alex SRE: grabbing dashboards. p95 ~ 1.1s, p99 spiking to 4.8s over last 6m. Error rate still low but tail latency and queue depth climbing on cyclone-dedicated-pool-3.
Jamal (infra): I see pod CPU steady but GPU util on pool nodes at 92%, RT queues growing. No infra deploys in last 20m. Autoscale not triggered — min replicas locked to 2 for this pool.
Priya (oncall): Who changed pool config? Was a commit recently that could block autoscale?
Maya (mlops): There was a model variant rollout for Cyclone earlier today to a quantized variant (v2-q4_8). Latency profile usually better, but kv-cache hit rate dropped after the roll. Possible cache warmup issue.
Rachel (acct): Cyclone SRE reporting customer-visible slowness, some paying tenants seeing degraded UX. They're on hold with Support; sharing their contact: cyclone-sre (in thread).
cyclone-sre: Confirmed — our dashboard shows high p99 and occasional 504s for image-captioning endpoint. Traffic surged due to a batch job. Please advise mitigation options ASAP.
Priya (oncall): OK. Short plan: 1) Pause/rollback model rollout for Cyclone to previous variant 2) Scale pool replicas up to warm capacity 3) Add temporary routing to warm spare region if needed 4) If noisy batch is tenant-caused, apply request-rate throttle for that tenant. I'll coordinate.
Jamal (infra): Running scale now: `redwoodctl pool scale --pool cyclone-dedicated-pool-3 --replicas 5` — ETA ~90s to have new nodes ready. I'll also temporarily lift min replica lock.
Alex SRE: Rolling back model for Cyclone to v1-stable on a canary route. Command: ```
redwoodctl model rollback --customer cyclone --from v2-q4_8 --to v1-stable --canary 10%
```
Maya (mlops): Can confirm v1-stable has higher cache hit rate historically. Kicking canary to 100% for Cyclone now to eliminate variant as cause.
cyclone-sre: Appreciate the fast response. If you can route our production traffic to the previous model while we pause the batch, that'll help.
Priya (oncall): Routing update: `routing-policy set cyclone --pool cyclone-dedicated-pool-3 --variant v1-stable` in progress. Also enabling prefix KV caching: `redwoodctl cache enable --customer cyclone --prefix true`
Jamal (infra): New replicas are coming up. Observability shows GPU util dropping to 68% after canary rollback and scale. p99 decreased to ~1.4s in last 30s.
Priya (oncall): Great. Ask Cyclone to pause the large batch if possible. Rachel, coordinate with customer.
Rachel (acct): On it — messaging them now. Cyclone says they can shift the batch start by 30 mins.
cyclone-sre: We'll pause the batch for 25–30 minutes. Thanks — monitoring shows immediate improvement.
Maya (mlops): I'll keep KV cache warmed; re-run a few synthetic requests to prime caches. Also flagging rollout metrics so we don't auto-promote v2-q4_8 until validated.
Alex SRE: Creating post-incident action items: 1) Adjust autoscale policy to allow burst for dedicated pools 2) Add preflight check for model rollouts that measures cache hit sensitivity 3) Add tenant-level throttles for large batch windows 4) Run chaos test on warm spares.
Priya (oncall): For now we mark incident as mitigated — p99 back to ~1.2s and no errors. Leaving open for 30m monitoring. If things hold, we'll close. Thanks everyone. :heart:
